# Question runs (MEASURE.md)

- `questions-*.tsv`: id, type, question. Answers and pages are in `reports/M3.6-first-question-runs.md`.
- `run-set.sh <questions> <pdf> <outdir>` runs both arms; `report.py <outdir>` prints the ledger.
- The PDFs live in `private/testset/` and the run logs in `private/eval/`; neither is committed.
